text:
encops-bot: :warning: Backup restore failed: tenant-78 restore_id=rst-2026-03-22-77 error=InvalidCiphertextException (kms key mismatch)

noah: seeing a cluster of these restores fail since 02:07 UTC, started right after last night's CMK rotate. anyone triaging?

maya: which restore path? db snapshots or object-store incremental bundles?

trent: both. quick inspect of object metadata:
```
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-backups --key tenant78/2026-03-21/pg-snap-0001.tar.gz
{ "Metadata": { "x-enc-key": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/old-cmk-2025", "enc-generated-at": "2025-11-30T03:10:00Z" } }
```
restore process tries to decrypt with new CMK and KMS returns InvalidCiphertextException (key mismatch).

sanjay: rotation job replaced active CMK and pruned legacy grants. the old CMK still exists but its key policy was tightened preventing grant recreation. I attempted `aws kms create-grant` and got `NotAuthorizedException` from KMS.

iris: :facepalm: rotation sequence: 1) create new CMK 2) update app-uploaders to use new key for new snapshots 3) remove legacy grants 4) publish new key policy. looks like step 3 ran before step 4 - we tightened policy as part of the directory-lockdown change so ops can't re-grant.

noah: impact? how many customers affected?

oncall: estimate 4 failed restores, 1 customer in degraded RTO. mark P2. Incident runbook `restore-ticketing` open.

encops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-22-77 created. Severity=P2. Actions: triage, temporary remediation, postmortem.

maya: short-term options: A) Temporarily revert key policy change to allow `kms:CreateGrant` for `infra-restore` role B) Rewrap affected snapshots (copy+encrypt with new CMK) C) Serve restores from warm-region where grants still exist (if any)

trent: A is fastest. B is safest long-term but will take hours for multiple TBs. C risky and uncertain.

sanjay: small test: `aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/old-cmk-2025` returned empty. `aws kms get-key-policy` shows policy disallows CreateGrant except to `rotation-service` principal. rotation-service pruned grants earlier.

iris: I'm drafting a scoped policy rollback: add a 1-hour statement allowing `arn:aws:iam::111:role/infra-restore` the `kms:CreateGrant` and `kms:Decrypt` actions limited to grant creation only. pinging @sec-lead for fast approval. PR: https://git.internal/policies/kms/PR-801

sec-lead: approved (looks like operational necessity). limit to 1h and require annotated audit ticket.

noah: after we create the grant, run 1) tenant-78 restore test 2) sample db-snapshot restore (non-prod) 3) smoke restores for 2 more customers. If all green, we can mark mitigated and schedule rewrap migration.

maya: logging: run CloudTrail search for `InvalidCiphertextException` and `Decrypt` failures between 02:00-02:30 UTC. also capture S3 Object versions which reference `old-cmk-2025`.

sanjay: CloudTrail snippet: `2026-03-22T02:09:07Z KMS InvalidCiphertextException arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/old-cmk-2025 Principal=role/uploader-serviceacct`

oncall: confirm micro-rollback window? sec-lead gave verbal. iris, apply rollback with audit annotation and notify postmortem channel.

iris: rollback applied at 02:20 UTC, created grant for `role/uploader-serviceacct` with Decrypt. test restore succeeded at 02:37 UTC for tenant-78. marking incident mitigated but not closed. will keep incident open for migration tasks.

encops-bot: Incident INC-2026-03-22-77 status=mitigated by iris at 02:37 UTC.

trent: follow-ups assigned: @maya update rotation playbook to enforce grant-recreate-before-prune; @sanjay schedule a rewrap batch for pre-rotation snapshots older than 90 days; @noah add CloudTrail alert on Decrypt failure spikes; @iris write postmortem + publish timeline + PR diffs. ETA 3d.

noah: vuln triage: this is procedural. we didn't detect exfil or compromise, but the race in rotation order is a reliability risk. include remediation checklist and CI smoke for key-rotation PRs.

maya: I'll add an automated verifier in the rotation pipeline: after rotation PR merges, run a 'restore-smoke' that attempts to decrypt a canary object encrypted under old key and confirm grants exist or rewrap completed.

noah: thanks team. keep the incident page updated and link backups rewrap run once scheduled. closing thread after PMR published. :white_check_mark:
